summary: 7-phase plan written and strict-validated (0 warnings). Phase 1 captures the HEAD --wfail --iofail baseline so later phases judge the gate by set-difference, never exit code (Finding 6). Phases 2-4 promote both witnesses into CslibTests/ (module mode, doubled Mathlib tactic meta-imports, 9 #guard_msgs assertions, 7 verbose evals dropped, barrel registration, docstrings). Phases 5-6 repoint all 14 citations, treating Scheme.lean:3474 as a 14th repair site rather than a template (Finding 8). Phase 7 is the full gate. Estimated 5.5 hours across 6 waves; one genuine parallel wave (Phases 4 and 5, disjoint trees).
key_findings: Report figure corrected at plan time: Finding 5's '14 bare #evals' and 'five verbose ones' are wrong. Direct count at HEAD gives 16 #evals (lines 252-256, 327-332, 392-396); the enumerated lists (9 keep, 7 drop) are authoritative and total 16. Plan uses 16/9/7 and still requires grep re-confirmation.

Phase 1 exists solely to convert the already-red --wfail --iofail gate from an unusable exit-code signal into a usable set-difference signal. Acceptance is 'failing-target set unchanged from baseline plus the two new targets green', explicitly not 'pipeline green'.
Phases 2 and 3 are serialized (not parallel) because both must edit the shared CslibTests.lean barrel; Phases 4 and 5 are genuinely parallel (CslibTests/ vs Cslib/Logics/Propositional/Tableau/).

Verification tiers assigned deliberately, not by default: Phase 4 (docstrings) is `local` not `prose` because Lean /-- --/ doc comments compile; Phases 5-6 (comment edits) are `local` not `prose` because three lines need rewrapping and site #12 sits inside a docstring.

Fixing the pre-existing --wfail red, promoting PersistPrototype.lean, promoting the 5 uncited probes, and re-adjudicating any verdict are all explicit Non-Goals. The archive-path fragility under a future vault renumbering is recorded as an accepted known consequence, not a surprise.

Rollback guidance is asymmetric and stated: promotion alone (Phases 1-4) is separately shippable; citation repair alone is not, since it would point at files that do not yet exist. If work must stop mid-task, stop after Phase 4.
